nodes.description: address private owner; privileged address set to msg.sender in constructor, gates init/setTradeAddress/batchSend/delegate and is whitelisted in ensure()
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token ledger mutated by transferFrom, batchSend and constructor
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spend approvals written by approve and reduced in transferFrom
uint public totalSupply; set once in constructor from _supply*(10**decimals)
address tradeAddress; extra whitelisted address settable only by owner, bypasses sale conditions in ensure()
address constant UNI = 0x7a250d...488D; hardcoded router address, never compared as sender but used in ensure logic
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom, read by condition()
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist consulted by ensure() (always false, never written)
uint256 private _minSale; lower bound on transfer value enforced in condition(), written by init()
uint256 private _maxSale; upper bound on transfer value enforced in condition(), written by init()
uint256 private _saleNum; max number of sales per address enforced in condition(), written by init()
function transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
function transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable; core value-moving routine: allowance decrement, ensure() gate, balance moves and _onSaleNum increment
function approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without zero-first check
function ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view; whitelist bypass (owner/tradeAddress/canSale/_UNI) else requires condition()
function condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view; sale-window checks against _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale/_onSaleNum
function delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied target and calldata
function init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) public; owner-only configuration of _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum (payable return-less path)
function batchSend(address[] memory _tos, uint _value) public payable; owner-only mass distribution with unchecked multiplications/additions and duplicated Transfer events
function setTradeAddress(address addr) public; owner-only setter of the whitelisted tradeAddress used to bypass ensure()
function pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure; CREATE2 address derivation used by ensure() for the _UNI comparison
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; sets owner=msg.sender, mints totalSupply to owner and grants infinite allowance to the router
msg.sender; caller-controlled address used as _from in transfer, as owner check in privileged functions and in approve
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate(); executes arbitrary code supplied by the caller in the token's storage context
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value; unchecked subtraction guarded only by a require on the read value
balanceOf[_from] -= _value; unchecked subtraction in transferFrom relying on a preceding require
balanceOf[_to] += _value and uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend; unchecked addition/multiplication can overflow
parameter _from of transferFrom/ensure; debited address, whitelist subject
parameter _to of transferFrom/ensure; credited address, not validated against address(0)
parameter _value of transfer/transferFrom/ensure/condition; transfer amount compared against sale bounds
parameter _spender of approve(); approval target without zero-address or zero-allowance checks
parameter a of delegate(); arbitrary target contract of the delegatecall
parameter b of delegate(); arbitrary calldata executed inside the token context
parameter saleNum of init(); written to _saleNum
parameter token of init(); min sale amount basis, scaled by decimals
parameter maxToken of init(); max sale amount basis, scaled by decimals
parameter _tos (address[]) of batchSend(); recipient list, unbounded loop length
parameter _value of batchSend(); per-recipient amount, multiplied by array length
parameter addr of setTradeAddress(); becomes the whitelisted tradeAddress that bypasses ensure()
local uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend; unchecked multiplication
loop index uint i in batchSend; drives the unbounded recipient iteration
local address _UNI = pairFor(...) in ensure(); computed pair address compared against _from
uint constant public decimals = 18; scaling factor for totalSupply and init() sale bounds

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the _from argument when transfer() forwards to transferFrom()
msg.sender controls _from and is compared against _from for the allowance branch in transferFrom()
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] from caller-controlled input
caller controls execution of delegate(); the only guard is require(msg.sender == owner)
init() is gated solely by require(msg.sender == owner), letting the owner rewrite sale bounds
batchSend() is gated solely by require(msg.sender == owner) and mints balances to attacker-chosen recipients
setTradeAddress() is gated solely by require(msg.sender == owner) and installs a whitelist bypass
deployer becomes owner in the constructor and receives the entire supply plus infinite router allowance
transfer() returns transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value), so the caller enters the core transfer routine
transferFrom() requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances
ensure() falls through to require(condition(_from, _value)) when no whitelist match is found
ensure() derives the pair address through pairFor() before the whitelist comparison
delegate() reaches the arbitrary a.delegatecall(b) instruction after the owner check
_value flows from transferFrom() into the unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value decrement
_value flows from transferFrom() into the unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value decrement
_value and _tos.length flow into unchecked uint total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[_to] += _value
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to]
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value
transfer() ultimately moves balances through the shared balanceOf ledger
batchSend() decrements balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits balanceOf[_to] for each recipient
ensure() compares _from and _to against owner for the whitelist bypass
ensure() allows any transfer where _from equals the owner-settable tradeAddress
ensure() compares _from against the hardcoded UNI constant
ensure() delegates value/sale-limit enforcement that reads _onSaleNum
ensure() consults canSale[_from] as an additional whitelist bypass
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] and rejects callers that already exceeded _saleNum
condition() requires _value >= _minSale when _minSale is set
condition() requires _value <= _maxSale when _maxSale is set
condition() returns false when _saleNum == 0 and both bounds are zero, otherwise enforces it per address
init() writes _minSale from the token parameter scaled by decimals
init() writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter scaled by decimals
init() writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter
init() uses the decimals constant to scale the min/max sale bounds
setTradeAddress() writes the owner-chosen addr into tradeAddress
the constructor sets owner = msg.sender, granting every privileged function to the deployer
the constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole totalSupply
the constructor sets allowance[msg.sender][router] = uint(-1) (infinite approval)
the constructor initializes totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals)
the _from parameter is the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom()
the _from parameter is the subject of every whitelist comparison in ensure()
the _to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom()
the _value parameter drives the allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom()
the _value parameter is forwarded from ensure() into the sale-condition check
the _value parameter is compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition()
the _spender parameter becomes the approval key in allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
the a parameter is the arbitrary delegatecall target in delegate()
the b parameter is the arbitrary calldata passed to the delegatecall in delegate()
the saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum by init()
the token parameter is scaled by decimals into _minSale by init()
the maxToken parameter is scaled by decimals into _maxSale by init()
the _tos array bounds the unbounded loop and multiplies the transferred total in batchSend()
the batchSend _value parameter is multiplied by _tos.length and added per recipient
the addr parameter is written into the whitelist-bypassing tradeAddress state variable
the local total is computed and checked against balanceOf[msg.sender] before distribution
the loop index i controls iteration over the caller-supplied recipient array
the local _UNI computed via pairFor() is compared with _from in the whitelist check

the _to parameter only carries the credited address into transferFrom
the _value parameter is the amount consumed by transferFrom arithmetic and condition checks

the maxToken parameter is merely scaled into _maxSale by init

the addr parameter is stored verbatim into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress
